messages:
Ivy Tran: quick sync  proposing a micro-launch for tiny-refapp: 2 short tutorials + refapp + bench note. goal: low friction dev onboarding.
Marco Silva: 👍 What are the must-haves?
Ivy Tran: 1) getting-started tutorial (5 min), 2) tuning guide (8 min), 3) refapp repo with docker quickstart, bench CSV, and reproducibility README. short blog ties them.
Samira Noor: I'll draft the tutorials. Marco, can you scaffold the refapp and include a `results/` folder for bench artifacts?
Marco Silva: yes. repo structure: /tutorials/01-quickstart, /tutorials/02-tuning, /refapp/docker, /refapp/bench. will push branch Thu.
LaunchBot: Reminder: add utm_source=tiny_refapp&utm_campaign=launch to all links.
Ivy Tran: inbound flow: blog CTA -> HubSpot list `tiny_refapp_launch`, tag `tiny_refapp`. drip: how-to, bench notes, invite to office hours.
Samira Noor: timeline: drafts by Fri EOD, bench CSV Mon, blog copy Mon, social assets Tue, launch Wed. everyone ok?
Marco Silva: fine. I'll include a one-command docker run and a minimal env var example with API_KEY only.
Ivy Tran: keep bench claims conservative and include raw CSV. Samira, include bench commands in the tutorial.
Samira Noor: will do.
Ivy Tran: I'll own publish ops. will create a Notion checklist and assign tasks.
Marco Silva: :+1: branch pushed -> will ping once CI completes.
LaunchBot: Action created: content/launch/tiny-refapp checklist (owner: Ivy Tran).
